en.title: What to Do If You Buy a Defective Product
en.directAnswer: Keep the receipt, warranty, packaging and proof of the defect. Contact the seller in writing and ask for the remedy you believe applies. If the issue falls within Bangladesh consumer law, you can check the official DNCRP complaint route. Do not throw away the product or evidence before the dispute is recorded.

en.lawMeaning: DNCRP’s official complaint guidance requires a written complaint and purchase evidence such as the receipt for the relevant goods or services. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
evidence: Receipt; invoice; warranty; product photos; packaging; advertisement; seller messages; payment proof.
en.simpleExample: A new blender stops working after one day. The buyer keeps the receipt and records the fault before returning it, rather than handing it over with no proof.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: repairing the item before documenting the defect.
